newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Proxima slips to 14-3/4.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Proxima slips to 14-3/4.

text.p: Proxima Corp slipped to 14-3/4 from a close of 16-1/2 on the NASDAQ National Market in after-hours trading after it reported a drop in its third quarter earnings to $0.25 a share from $0.46 for the same period last year, traders said Monday.
One trader said HBO & Co was trading at the same as its close of 68.
The company reported fourth-quarter operating earnings of $0.35 a share against $0.20 for the same period last year. The $0.35 a share figure came before charges.
The New York Stock Exchange said Monday session one had a volume of 92,800 shares against Friday's 30,100, while session two had 277,900 against 2,171,000.
